subject: Codacy critical was NOT the DSN. ranking-candidates.ts:202 dynamic dispatch. Fixed b41510f61.
body:
CORRECTION of my earlier inference that Codacy critical = the DSN.

OBSERVATION (check-run 105795141403 annotations, after 3c0ae8dc9):
- critical security: packages/types/src/ranking-candidates.ts:202 'Using non-static data to retrieve and run functions from the object is dangerous.' That is ORDERING_BY_NAME[name](a,b).
- medium compatibility: docs/ops/proposals/2026-09-18-clv-same-book.sql:1 'Expected SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON near top of file'. Codacy applied SQL Server lint to a Postgres ALTER TABLE proposal.

I replaced the map lookup with a switch on the closed RankingOrderingName union. ORDERING_BY_NAME remains for iteration. ranking-candidates.test.ts collected 10, passed 10. Pushed b41510f61.

I will not add SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON to a Postgres proposal. That medium is a false compatibility finding.

GitGuardian 37443000 still flags commit b71d9c04 in the 19-commit PR scan. HEAD no longer contains the shape. Founder: dismiss the incident (synthetic) or authorize a history rewrite. I will not rewrite.
